sources.title: pre2post-chess/sft at main · pavelslab-nyu/pre2post-chess
sources.snippet: Requirements Python 3.10+ with: torch, transformers, accelerate, omegaconf, python-chess, numpy, pandas, tqdm, wandb (optional, for logging). A Stockfish binary (used to label search trees). 1+ GPU for SFT and for model-policy CoT generation. Random / Stockfish-policy CoT generation is CPU-only.
